enchantments.tooltip: +8 Enhancement Bonus: +8 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Doublestrike 6%: Passive: 6% Enhancement bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Resistance +10: Passive: +10 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Hardened Spikes: The sharp, hardened spikes on this item deal an additional 4d6 Piercing damage when used to strike an enemy.
